RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown; a defensible number cannot be assigned from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias—just as an all-men panel would not be. Your qualifications make your disappointment understandable, but a head-of-function role may prioritise leadership, regulatory expertise and stakeholder management over academic credentials. The announcement may omit relevant experience.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, how you were assessed against them, and feedback on the successful candidate’s relative strengths.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges, such as sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria or unequal treatment. If you might challenge the decision, check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
